name: Blockade Breaker
_: Region 1's boss (owner decision H, 2026-10-04): the layered fortress Blockade Breaker of docs/boss-concepts.md, style 1. Two layers: the armour plates ARE the hull's lower face (layer 1, rows 3-7); four pulse cannons and the emitter slot sit recessed behind them in the deep layer (rows 1-3). gun-2 sits in an open bay and fires from the first frame; the others open fire once their plates fall. The emitter slot (slot 1) is enabled on levels 1-4 (decision 8) and fires its laser once plate-d falls (S4b, owner decisions of 2026-10-06). The boss falls with its last weapon; armour left standing is not required. Placeholder art drawn by the agent (decision G); the owner retouches the PNGs. A destroyed module disappears (owner decision L): its top cavityRows rows, inside the hull, become a plain cavity, the rows below it band background - every plate hangs below the hull (0), the cannons and the emitter sit inside it. docs/level-authoring.md, 'The boss', is the format; plan §5.15 the design. Hit points: decision I's MEDIUM target is 90-120 s since owner decision 6 of 2026-10-07 (was 45-60 s): every plate and cannon doubled - plates by size 12 / 16 / 20 (were 6 / 8 / 10), cannons 28 (were 14) - and the emitter doubled to 20 (owner decision 5); boss_def keeps its per-difficulty scale (x 3/4, x 1, x 5/4). MEASURED with the director-complete bot: EASY 81.3, MEDIUM 101.8, HARD 130.5 s. M8 tunes on hardware. Scores packed BCD.
_seeThrough: Owner decisions M and O (plan §5.16): the only see-through hull art is the girders' stubs one row under the hull line; every other hull cell stops a shot. Decision O (supersedes M1): no hull art below any weapon - the hull's lower strip is cut under gun-1 and the emitter and beside gun-2's and gun-4's bases, gun-4's row-4 pieces under it removed; every weapon hangs in its own recess. Decision N: the open bay is columns 25-29; gun-3 behind plate-e alone; the cowl plates removed (out of reach).

palette._: COLPF0 light steel (the plates' face), COLPF1 mid grey (bevels, trim), COLPF2 amber (cannons, lights, damage glow, sparks, flames), COLPF3 dark burgundy (the hull's bulk). The band never flashes (S4b.5, owner decision of 2026-10-07).

motion._: The band drifts one colour clock every framesPerColourClock frames across travelColourClocks and back (plan §5.2): the window shows band columns 0-55 over the travel, so both engine ends come into view in turn; the win shakes it by HSCROL jitter (Q-S5).

chain._: The win: blasts along every module, the surviving armour included (§5.13.2 item 10).

fire._: One countdown (§5.13.2 item 6): the next armed cannon fires when it reaches 0 and the countdown restarts from that cannon's reload (EASY +1/2, HARD -1/4), never under this cooldown. gun-2's slower reload opens the fight; the faster cannons behind the plates raise the rate as they are exposed.

capped._: An emitter slot the level's laser tier does not enable (decision 8: 1 / 2 / 4 slots on levels 1-4 / 5-8 / 9-12) becomes armour with the capped plate (extras.png) and these hit points.

laser._: S4b (owner decisions Q3, Q11, 2026-10-06): an emitter's laser fires for beamFrames after its warning (the emitter's bottom cell heats, the line pulses, a rising tone on channel 3). S4b.1 (owner decision D3): the warning and the reload are the level's, per difficulty (bossDef laserWarning, laserReload); an emitter is never in the pulse rotation and carries no reload (D1). Placeholder; M8 tunes it.

nozzles._: The engine nozzles at both ends (decision K): the cells that show the left and the right nozzle glyph; their three phases (extras.png) cycle every framesPerPhase frames and go dark on the win's first blast.

modules._: The emitter (owner decisions of 2026-10-07, S4b.4): design 1, the projector tower - a stepped tower narrowing to a mast, amber coils on it, flaring into a round lens collar; its art is emitter.png (rest, heat A, heat B, cracked, broken), painted over band, open, cracked and broken at this footprint. Three cells by three at columns 31-33, rows 1-3, its bottom level with gun-2's and gun-4's; the lens is the bottom row's centre cell, where the beam (M1 / M2, $46) leaves it and the warning heats it with the emitter's own glyphs (E2). Only the lens has damage stages ("stages": "lens"): its own cracked and dark looks; the tower keeps its look until destroyed (decision L), when the cavity fills all three rows. Durability x 2 (owner decision 5): 20 hit points. Every plate shares one cracked and one broken look, to make room in the charset.
modules.name: emitter

_decisionN: Owner decision N (plan §5.16.7): the open bay is columns 25-29 - gun-2 (26-28) with one clear column each side; gun-1 moved to 22-24 so plate-c (21-24) still covers all of it; plate-b 17-20, plate-d 30-34. The cowl plates under the engine housings are removed: a player shot starts at the fighter's centre (HPOS 56 at the left-most), so their columns were in reach at 8-20 of the band's 64 positions.
